rationale: This is a single-input swap on the archive's one winner, and the swap makes the shortfall term ≈ negative change in book equity (clean-surplus identity), so the "test" mostly rediscovers the equity-shrinkage/retained-earnings dimension rather than isolating the cash-coverage mechanism the reasoning claims.

A modest but legitimate identification exercise — the hard median gate cleanly separates the interaction from a valuation-weighted main effect and the sign logic is internally consistent — though it is close to a construction variant of the archived winner and mirrors gating patterns already tried in the archive.

The mechanical argument is actually sound (a debt-funded buyback leaves EV roughly unchanged while mechanically inflating P/B), so replacing the conditioning multiple with EV/sales is a substantive de-contamination rather than cosmetic, but it remains one axis of the same archived family and EV/sales carries strong persistent industry-level variation that will dominate the gate.

Smoothing the cash-generation benchmark to a three-year mean is directly implied by the "chronic external dependence" claim rather than decorative, and the expression matches the hypothesis and sign, but it is still an incremental refinement of the archived winner with a predictable modest effect on precision.

The hypothesis is about time-varying issuance windows, but level-minus-industry-demeaned recovers the industry *mean level* of sstk/at, which is dominated by persistent cross-industry composition (biotech vs utilities) and by option-exercise proceeds — so the expression measures industry identity, not a hot-market wave, and the interaction risks being a disguised industry-tilt bet.

The materiality threshold and sales-based multiple are targeted repairs of two real defects in the flat archived issuer-valuation signal, but the underlying claim that issuance underperformance concentrates in richly valued firms is close to the published Loughran-Ritter/Daniel-Titman result, so novelty is limited and the sstk-based gate still mixes SEOs with routine share sales.
